validity.researcher_notes: Confirmed existence and route via three independent origins: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects (Aug2026 dated release, sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' row 42: 'New Pipeline', Donlin Gold LLC operator, 316 mi, 14 in, 73 MMcf/d, buried pipeline 'from Cook Inlet in Southcentral Alaska to the Donlin open-pit gold mine site in the Kuskokwim River region'); Anchorage Daily News/Alaska Beacon (James Brooks, 2026-01-16, adn.com) describing the same route ('Beluga power plant on Cook Inlet to mine site near Kuskokwim River'), a proposed contract-carrier design, $1.8-2B company cost estimate, and 2027 FID timeline; Alaska Business Magazine (2026-01-09, akbizmag.com) confirming the ~315-mile route and a new Jan 2026 non-binding letter of intent between Donlin Gold and Glenfarne/Alaska LNG (P0147) to cooperate on gas supply (up to 50 MMcf/d) and delivery infrastructure. Two open data-quality issues are filed separately below (SegmentCost three-way disagreement; stale StartYear1=2024).

EIA's own sub-label is 'On Hold' (since the 2026-01 release; 'Approved/On Hold' 2024-10..2025-10; 'Approved' 2020-03..2024-07), but this describes a specific court-ordered construction bar (US District Court, June 2025, pending a NEPA supplement re: tailings-dam risk) layered on top of an otherwise actively advancing project, not dormancy: Alaska Supreme Court upheld the state pipeline right-of-way and water-use permits 2025-11-14; the project received a FAST-41 federal fast-track designation Oct 2025; ownership was restructured (Barrick exited April 2025, Paulson Advisers + NovaGold took over) closing June 2025; Donlin Gold and Glenfarne/Alaska LNG (P0147) signed a new non-binding gas-supply letter of intent 2026-01-09; and Donlin Gold's permitting manager told Alaska's Regulatory Commission in Jan 2026 that FID is targeted for 2027 with a bankable feasibility study underway. This level of ongoing regulatory, commercial and corporate activity as of Jan 2026 does not fit the '2y proposed->shelved' dormancy pattern, so verdict=confirm rather than change/stale.
